en: 1 Kings 10

p.src: 1  When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.

en: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the LORD’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.

p.src: 2  She came to Jerusalem with a very great caravan, with camels that bore spices, very much gold, and precious stones; and when she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

ja: んだらくだを連れてエルサレムに
た。彼女はソロモンのところに
にあるすべてのことを

en: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from the king which he didn’t tell her.

en: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

p.src: 5  the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

en: the food of his table, the sitting of his servants, the attendance of his officials, their clothing, his cup bearers, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

p.src: 6  She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

en: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
u.src: 6  She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

p.src: 7  However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

ja: じませんでした。実に、その半分も聞かされてはいませんでした。あなたの
いた名声をはるかに超えています。
en: However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.
u.src: 7  However, I didn’t believe the words until I came and my eyes had seen it. Behold, not even half was told me! Your wisdom and prosperity exceed the fame which I heard.

って知恵を聞く、あなたの
en: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.
u.src: 8  Happy are your men, happy are these your servants who stand continually before you, who hear your wisdom.

p.src: 9  Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

ja: び、あなたをイスラエルの

はイスラエルをとこしえに
されたので、公正と義を行わせるために、あなたを
en: Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”
u.src: 9  Blessed is the LORD your God, who delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Israel. Because the LORD loved Israel forever, therefore he made you king, to do justice and righteousness.”

p.src: 10  She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

en: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
u.src: 10  She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

en: 10:11 possibly an Indian sandalwood, with nice grain and a pleasant scent, and good for woodworking

p.src: 12  The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.

ja: の家のための柱を造り、また
と弦楽器を造った。今日に至るまで、そのようなアルムグの木が
られたこともなかった。
en: The king made of the almug trees pillars for the LORD’s house and for the king’s house, harps also and stringed instruments for the singers; no such almug trees came or were seen to this day.

p.src: 13  King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

ja: は、王の気前から贈ったもののほかに、シェバの
en: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.
u.src: 13  King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

p.src: 14  Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

タラント の金であった。
en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

en: 10:14 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces, so 666 talents is about 20 metric tons

p.src: 15  in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.

ja: このほかに、貿易商たちが持って来たもの、

たちからのものがあった。
en: in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed people, and of the governors of the country.

p.src: 16  King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.

ja: シェケル の金が使われた。
en: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.
u.src: 16  King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.

en: 10:16 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces, so 600 shekels is about 6 kilograms or 13.2 pounds or 192 Troy ounces.

p.src: 17  He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

ja: ミナ の金が使われた。
はそれらをレバノンの
en: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three minas of gold went to one shield; and the king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

en: 10:17 A mina is about 600 grams or 1.3 U. S. pounds.
